# Checking referential integrity in the ilias database

## Description
* Checker script for the ilias database
* First searches for all existing obj_id's in the object_data table
* Searching for all tables with the obj_id column that are having an obj_id that does not exist anymore
* Does not exist anymore means: It's not part of object_data anymore 


## Starting
* Run index.php for starting
* Then there will be the autogenerated file check_tables_generated.php
* Run check_tables_generated.php
* Then there will be the file problematic_tables_obj.txt with all problems found in the database according to obj_id
